ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, with high-intensity pixels primarily localized to scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark grey/black pigment across >90% of the visible surface area. High-contrast white/cream clusters are concentrated at the distal tips and leading edge margins, with sparse, discrete white focal points scattered across the central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex; the angle is approximately 50 degrees with a depth of roughly 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple distinct peaks (sawtooth shape) observed along the upper margin of both lobes, with amplitudes varying between 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges, sweeping upward toward pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast clusters of barnacle colonization (rosettes) at both distal tips and along portions of the leading edge. Numerous discrete, small white circular scars distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant V-shaped linear scratch on the right lobe (viewer's right) and multiple smaller, unaligned thin white linear streaks (rake marks) on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips and a prominent chevron-shaped linear scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'V' or 'lambda' shaped white scratch mark located in the mid-region of the right lobe.
